status: authored progressive scene plan; not playable dialogue yet
prologue: Rain, the missing infant, Amara seeing Victor, locked exits, the plea to David. End on the three approaches. Do not explain the inheritance, passage or accomplice.
Each approach begins with a different first action. Establish where Amara saw Victor; preserve her account without inventing a recording of the ransom call.
The external gate was not forced. An innocent delivery worker can be excluded. The house itself becomes the question.
Victor demands money. Amara denies he has any claim. David must ask where that supposed debt comes from; defer the full answer.
Reveal that Ethan inherited a private provision from his father. Victor is not that father. Keep the identity and death history incomplete.
A threatening message includes a detail from inside the house. Its sender knew more than a casual observer; establish a source worth testing.
Amara recalls paying the rent while Victor spoke of his aura. One brief domestic memory explains his habit; avoid narrating the entire relationship.
A planted trace is detected before the team acts against its apparent owner. The player protects an innocent person rather than simply losing a lead.
David admits his first technical interpretation was wrong. Amara identifies a household routine absent from the logs. Their skills complement each other.
Amara acknowledges her suspicion that Victor was involved in the father's death, then explicitly distinguishes fear from evidence. No killer is named.
A verified witness places a service vehicle near the house. Preserve the witness and record; do not immediately make the witness disappear.
Victor learns David is helping. Reveal that he approached Amara after the funeral and she refused him. Show jealousy rather than a second aura lecture.
The vehicle record leads to an estate service arrangement. First hint of the wealthy family's continuing influence; no full conspiracy disclosure.
Someone tries to persuade Amara that she misunderstood what she saw. Physical details support her account. She truly saw Victor; the game will not reverse this into hallucination.
A poor image from inside the property can be restored. Establish which part matters before the player undertakes restoration. The image is evidence of a route, not a promised rescue.
The restored image places Victor beside an interior passage. It corroborates his presence without yet explaining how the closed house worked.
An access record bears Amara's credential while she was asleep. End the first fifty levels on this specific locked-house question, leading directly to episode 1.

episodes.title: The Borrowed Credential
episodes.entry: Amara's name appears in the access log.
episodes.discovery: Her credential was issued before she moved in.
episodes.hook: Who retained the original household account?

episodes.title: The Second Account
episodes.entry: David compares conflicting access records.
episodes.discovery: An estate service account remained active.
episodes.hook: Why did the estate still control access?

episodes.title: Rain Inside
episodes.entry: Morris examines water behind the bolted door.
episodes.discovery: The water came from an internal service stair.
episodes.hook: Why is the stair missing from the public plan?

episodes.title: A House Remembered
episodes.entry: Amara searches Adrian's ordinary household papers.
episodes.discovery: A maintenance invoice names a former attendant.
episodes.hook: The attendant has been ordered not to speak.

episodes.title: Before the Marriage
episodes.entry: The attendant asks why the family distrusts Amara.
episodes.discovery: Amara reveals Adrian's proposal and his family's refusal.
episodes.hook: Someone is recording the attendant's visitors.

episodes.title: The Unsent Warning
episodes.entry: David finds an intercepted warning to Amara.
episodes.discovery: An employee reported reused access before the kidnapping.
episodes.hook: Who stopped the message reaching her?

episodes.title: The Wrong Footprints
episodes.entry: An innocent worker is blamed for a trace.
episodes.discovery: Morris establishes that evidence was planted.
episodes.hook: Its source links to an estate contractor.

episodes.title: The Door Below
episodes.entry: The contractor's plan is recovered.
episodes.discovery: Victor could leave while the ordinary doors stayed locked.
episodes.hook: Someone had to release the internal service gate.

episodes.title: Someone Held It
episodes.entry: A witness describes a woman beside the exit.
episodes.discovery: Amara's sighting is corroborated: Victor had help.
episodes.hook: The woman wore an estate staff pin.

episodes.title: The First Promise Kept
episodes.entry: The team closes the compromised access.
episodes.discovery: The house is secured and the innocent worker cleared.
episodes.hook: The staff pin belongs to Adrian's household.

episodes.title: A Seat at the Table
episodes.entry: Amara seeks the household staff list.
episodes.discovery: Orena receives her but refuses to discuss Ethan's status.
episodes.hook: A clerk quietly offers another appointment.

episodes.title: The Clerk's Copy
episodes.entry: Nessa supplies a withheld payment record.
episodes.discovery: The contractor was paid after Adrian died.
episodes.hook: Who authorised the payment?

episodes.title: The Price of Shoes
episodes.entry: Victor claims Amara owes him her prosperity.
episodes.discovery: Amara recalls his aura boasts while she paid their rent.
episodes.hook: An old acquaintance saw him at the estate office.

episodes.title: Not a Stranger
episodes.entry: The acquaintance describes the meeting.
episodes.discovery: Victor met an estate intermediary before Adrian died.
episodes.hook: Can the meeting's date be established?

episodes.title: The Other Side of the Picture
episodes.entry: The complete photograph is recovered.
episodes.discovery: Victor met Kellan, the estate administrator.
episodes.hook: The photographer was paid through the household account.

episodes.title: The Proposal
episodes.entry: Amara explains why she left Victor.
episodes.discovery: He suggested exploiting Adrian; she refused and left him.
episodes.hook: Victor calls the introduction proof the fortune is his.

episodes.title: For His Son
episodes.entry: The bequest is distinguished from the throne dispute.
episodes.discovery: Adrian acknowledged Ethan and made him a private provision.
episodes.hook: The family's copy lacks a supporting page.

episodes.title: The Missing Page
episodes.entry: Nessa finds a filing receipt.
episodes.discovery: The omission predates the kidnapping.
episodes.hook: Where is the original page held?

episodes.title: A Request in Her Voice
episodes.entry: Amara personally challenges the withholding.
episodes.discovery: Her objection enters the record and cannot be described as consent.
episodes.hook: Kellan suspends Nessa's access.

episodes.title: Money Is Not a Father
episodes.entry: The authenticated record is preserved.
episodes.discovery: Victor's alleged debt is exposed as an unsupported demand.
episodes.hook: A payment refers to a private transfer of care.

episodes.title: Green Pin
episodes.entry: The pin identifies Lami, a former attendant.
episodes.discovery: She accepted work described as protecting Adrian's child.
episodes.hook: Lami has not collected her wages.

episodes.title: A Room for One Night
episodes.entry: Lami's booking is secured.
episodes.discovery: She left a note expressing fear of Ethan's collector.
episodes.hook: A witness saw her change vehicles.

episodes.title: The Patient Driver
episodes.entry: A driver asks for protection before speaking.
episodes.discovery: He heard Ethan cry after the house exit.
episodes.hook: Who comforted the baby?

episodes.title: The Cup She Packed
episodes.entry: The driver identifies Ethan's feeding cup.
episodes.discovery: The first independent sighting confirms Ethan alive that morning.
episodes.hook: Lami tried to telephone a clinic.

episodes.title: The Call She Couldn't Finish
episodes.entry: David verifies the call without exposing medical records.
episodes.discovery: Lami asked how to obtain help for a baby in her care.
episodes.hook: Another person interrupted her.

episodes.title: A Brother at the Yard
episodes.entry: Nessa's brother is threatened over her copies.
episodes.discovery: The team reaches him in time and brings him to safety.
episodes.hook: He saw the contractor's receiving desk.

episodes.title: The Receiving Desk
episodes.entry: His account identifies Lami's recruiter.
episodes.discovery: The recruiter used the royal household's name.
episodes.hook: She retained a signed instruction.

episodes.title: What Lami Believed
episodes.entry: Lami contacts Amara through a protected channel.
episodes.discovery: She believed a family custody dispute was being settled.
episodes.hook: Will she identify Victor directly?

episodes.title: A Place to Speak
episodes.entry: The player helps secure Lami's interview.
episodes.discovery: Lami confirms Victor carried Ethan from the service stair.
episodes.hook: Who supplied the instruction?

episodes.title: The First Accomplice
episodes.entry: Lami gives corroborating evidence and remains available.
episodes.discovery: The access conspiracy no longer rests solely on Amara's account.
episodes.hook: Kellan's authorisation appears on the transfer.

episodes.title: The Letter Victor Kept
episodes.entry: Victor sends part of an old love letter.
episodes.discovery: Amara recognises writing from before the separation.
episodes.hook: The missing ending changes its meaning.

episodes.title: The Last Week's Rent
episodes.entry: An old neighbour describes Amara leaving.
episodes.discovery: The separation preceded her acceptance of Adrian.
episodes.hook: Victor threatened to collect his reward later.

episodes.title: A Man Who Returned
episodes.entry: Amara remembers Adrian's visits to her stall.
episodes.discovery: Their relationship grew before his promise of marriage.
episodes.hook: A saved message records his argument with his family.

episodes.title: The Door She Wasn't Offered
episodes.entry: The family rejection is heard in context.
episodes.discovery: Opposition to the marriage began before Ethan's birth.
episodes.hook: Kellan handled Adrian's finances during that dispute.

episodes.title: The Name at Birth
episodes.entry: Adrian's acknowledgement is recovered.
episodes.discovery: He recognised Ethan despite his family's refusal.
episodes.hook: Why was it omitted from a later statement?

episodes.title: After the Funeral
episodes.entry: Victor's attempt to reclaim Amara is reconstructed.
episodes.discovery: She explicitly refused him rather than inviting negotiation.
episodes.hook: His messages changed from affection to payment.

episodes.title: Someone Who Listened
episodes.entry: David recalls repairing Amara's business website.
episodes.discovery: Their relationship began through ordinary trust.
episodes.hook: Who told Victor about them?

episodes.title: A Photograph Sent On
episodes.entry: The source of a relationship photograph is identified.
episodes.discovery: A household observer reported Amara and David to Victor.
episodes.hook: The observer thought they were helping reconciliation.

episodes.title: Do Not Decide for Me
episodes.entry: David wants to refuse Victor's meeting demand.
episodes.discovery: Amara and David agree on a plan together.
episodes.hook: Amara will speak while her allies verify the surroundings.

episodes.title: What He Really Wants
episodes.entry: Amara draws Victor into discussing the morning.
episodes.discovery: His knowledge corroborates the ransom evidence.
episodes.hook: He says the royal household paid for the car.

episodes.title: The First Car
episodes.entry: The payment is compared with Lami's account.
episodes.discovery: Kellan's office funded the first transfer.
episodes.hook: He calls it ordinary household work.

episodes.title: An Ordinary Invoice
episodes.entry: Nessa produces the instruction behind it.
episodes.discovery: The document falsely describes Amara as unable to care for Ethan.
episodes.hook: Its author never met her.

episodes.title: A Witness to a Stranger
episodes.entry: The author explains the source of the claim.
episodes.discovery: The assessment was manufactured from supplied allegations.
episodes.hook: A message promises discretion to the household.

episodes.title: The House Divides
episodes.entry: Orena confronts the transfer made in her name.
episodes.discovery: She approved an inquiry, not Victor's ransom.
episodes.hook: She prevents Kellan destroying the archive.

episodes.title: A Key Surrendered
episodes.entry: Orena releases a controlled record.
episodes.discovery: The team gains a durable source within the household.
episodes.hook: It identifies a private receiving house.

episodes.title: Not the Heir They Wanted
episodes.entry: Kellan's succession concerns are established.
episodes.discovery: His motive is distinct from Victor's financial grievance.
episodes.hook: A relative offers conditional help.

episodes.title: The Condition
episodes.entry: The offer requires Amara's silence.
episodes.discovery: She rejects the bargain without surrendering her evidence.
episodes.hook: A younger employee breaks ranks.

episodes.title: The Rooms Prepared
episodes.entry: The employee describes supplies ordered for Ethan.
episodes.discovery: The transfer included arrangements for infant care.
episodes.hook: One order names a carer outside Victor's circle.

episodes.title: Two Plans, One Child
episodes.entry: The correspondence is reconstructed.
episodes.discovery: Kellan wanted concealed custody; Victor converted it into ransom.
episodes.hook: The men are withholding information from each other.

episodes.title: An Order He Didn't Sign
episodes.entry: A later movement lacks either man's valid authority.
episodes.discovery: Another participant has taken initiative.
episodes.hook: Who now has responsibility for Ethan's care?

episodes.title: The Carer's Number
episodes.entry: The supply order yields a professional contact.
episodes.discovery: The contact is a real carer, not an invented identity.
episodes.hook: She requests a detail only Ethan's mother would know.

episodes.title: The Blue Stitch
episodes.entry: Amara describes a repair in Ethan's cover.
episodes.discovery: The carer correctly identifies the repaired seam.
episodes.hook: A trusted intermediary can arrange contact.

episodes.title: One Sound
episodes.entry: The carer supplies a brief recording.
episodes.discovery: Amara recognises Ethan, but its age is uncertain.
episodes.hook: A separate delivery record may date it.

episodes.title: The Delivery Bell
episodes.entry: A background sound is compared with the record.
episodes.discovery: Recent proof of life is independently supported.
episodes.hook: A new instruction orders movement.

episodes.title: No More Silent Cars
episodes.entry: The team confronts the transport contractor.
episodes.discovery: One available transport route is closed permanently.
episodes.hook: An alternative pickup is expected.

episodes.title: The Car That Never Came
episodes.entry: The pickup does not arrive.
episodes.discovery: The team's intervention prevents that relocation.
episodes.hook: The carer asks protection for another dependant.

episodes.title: A Promise to the Carer
episodes.entry: The player helps protect the threatened dependant.
episodes.discovery: The carer can cooperate without abandoning her family.
episodes.hook: She agrees to identify the current district.

episodes.title: The Wrong Window
episodes.entry: A recent photograph narrows the building type.
episodes.discovery: One candidate is eliminated before a reckless intervention.
episodes.hook: A visible repair identifies another candidate.

episodes.title: A Room with Light
episodes.entry: An independent source checks the candidate.
episodes.discovery: Ethan's location is narrowed to a small group of houses.
episodes.hook: The carer is warned that Victor is approaching.

episodes.title: Victor Outside
episodes.entry: Victor is independently seen at the district.
episodes.discovery: His claim of control can finally be tested.
episodes.hook: The people inside refuse to surrender Ethan to him.

episodes.title: He Has to Ask
episodes.entry: A witness hears Victor demand entry.
episodes.discovery: He no longer has unrestricted access to Ethan.
episodes.hook: Will he admit that to Amara?

episodes.title: A Demand Without a Picture
episodes.entry: Amara requests current proof.
episodes.discovery: Victor cannot verify what he still claims to control.
episodes.hook: He contacts Kellan for leverage.

episodes.title: The Call Between Them
episodes.entry: A preserved message records mutual blame.
episodes.discovery: Their partnership has broken down.
episodes.hook: Kellan claims he can reverse the transfer.

episodes.title: A Signature Withdrawn
episodes.entry: Amara challenges the instruction with authenticated records.
episodes.discovery: The original receiving authority is formally disputed.
episodes.hook: A replacement instruction is being prepared.

episodes.title: The Person Preparing It
episodes.entry: Nessa identifies the document handler.
episodes.discovery: The handler acts under a concealed household mandate.
episodes.hook: Can a witness prove they know about the abduction?

episodes.title: A Warning Received
episodes.entry: The warning's receipt is established.
episodes.discovery: Continued participation cannot be called innocent misunderstanding.
episodes.hook: The handler refuses the replacement instruction.

episodes.title: A Journey Prevented
episodes.entry: The stopped instruction is secured.
episodes.discovery: A planned relocation does not happen.
episodes.hook: The public address is not the actual nursery.

episodes.title: The Safe Address
episodes.entry: The carer explains a protected receiving address.
episodes.discovery: The listed office and the care location are distinct.
episodes.hook: A trusted authority must verify the real place.

episodes.title: Who May Enter
episodes.entry: The team establishes an agreed verification channel.
episodes.discovery: They gain a visit rather than another guessed address.
episodes.hook: Its sponsor is connected to Adrian's last appointment.

episodes.title: A Familiar Name
episodes.entry: The sponsor appears in Adrian's appointment book.
episodes.discovery: The kidnapping and his death share a documented connection.
episodes.hook: Did Adrian record that meeting?

episodes.title: The Appointment
episodes.entry: Amara retrieves Adrian's final diary entry.
episodes.discovery: He planned to dispute a household financial arrangement.
episodes.hook: A witness confirms he kept the appointment.

episodes.title: An Argument Overheard
episodes.entry: The witness describes a dispute about Ethan.
episodes.discovery: Adrian defended his son shortly before his death.
episodes.hook: Someone removed the room recording.

episodes.title: The Copy Nobody Claimed
episodes.entry: A separate recording copy is found.
episodes.discovery: The family was falsely told no copy remained.
episodes.hook: Its timing conflicts with the public account.

episodes.title: Before the Announcement
episodes.entry: The timeline is reconstructed.
episodes.discovery: An estate decision was prepared before the death announcement.
episodes.hook: Preparation alone does not prove murder.

episodes.title: What Suspicion Cannot Do
episodes.entry: Amara confronts the limits of her accusation.
episodes.discovery: Victor's estate visit is proved; his role in the death is not.
episodes.hook: He offers a different participant's name.

episodes.title: The Bargain Refused
episodes.entry: Victor asks to trade information for immunity from blame.
episodes.discovery: His statement is preserved without surrendering the ransom case.
episodes.hook: Can his offered name be independently checked?

episodes.title: Someone Else Was There
episodes.entry: A second source confirms the named participant.
episodes.discovery: Adrian's last evening involved more than Victor and Kellan.
episodes.hook: A departure record appears altered.

episodes.title: The Unchanged Original
episodes.entry: The original departure record is recovered.
episodes.discovery: The alteration happened after Adrian could challenge it.
episodes.hook: Its author is linked to the receiving authority.

episodes.title: His Own Voice
episodes.entry: Amara hears Adrian affirm his provision for Ethan.
episodes.discovery: His commitment is no longer merely reported by others.
episodes.hook: The recording mentions an emergency instruction.

episodes.title: The Letter for His Son
episodes.entry: That instruction is authenticated.
episodes.discovery: It supports action for Ethan without solving the death.
episodes.hook: The receiving authority must answer it.

episodes.title: An Answer Due
episodes.entry: The instruction reaches a named official.
episodes.discovery: Someone is accountable for verifying Ethan's placement.
episodes.hook: The official requests the birth acknowledgement.

episodes.title: His Father's Name
episodes.entry: The acknowledgement and supporting record are produced.
episodes.discovery: Adrian's relationship to Ethan is accepted.
episodes.hook: Kellan's representative raises another objection.

episodes.title: The Mother's Name
episodes.entry: Amara disproves the fabricated assessment.
episodes.discovery: The representative cannot keep reusing the same allegation.
episodes.hook: An intermediary fears public exposure.

episodes.title: The Intermediary's Fear
episodes.entry: The player separates Ethan's safety from the intermediary's liability.
episodes.discovery: A witness discloses the receiving procedure.
episodes.hook: The procedure names only two possible sites.

episodes.title: Two Houses
episodes.entry: Separate checks distinguish the sites.
episodes.discovery: One is administrative; one recently received infant supplies.
episodes.hook: A current confirmation can identify the placement.

episodes.title: Stay Where You Are
episodes.entry: The disputed movement instruction is put on hold.
episodes.discovery: Another relocation is prevented.
episodes.hook: A welfare visitor can now meet the carer.

episodes.title: Someone Sees Him
episodes.entry: The independent welfare visit occurs.
episodes.discovery: Ethan is confirmed alive and receiving care.
episodes.hook: A written obstruction prevents immediate return.

episodes.title: The Obstruction Named
episodes.entry: The obstruction is obtained.
episodes.discovery: It is a contested instruction, not an unexplained disappearance.
episodes.hook: Who has authority to set it aside?

episodes.title: Behind the Signatory
episodes.entry: Nessa traces delegated authority.
episodes.discovery: An office used another person's name to delay action.
episodes.hook: The person whose authority was borrowed agrees to intervene.

episodes.title: A Door No Longer Hidden
episodes.entry: The real authority repudiates the delay.
episodes.discovery: The team gains a specific institutional route toward Ethan.
episodes.hook: Victor discovers how much leverage he has lost.

episodes.title: The Last Ransom
episodes.entry: Victor demands payment again.
episodes.discovery: The team distinguishes his threat from his actual control.
episodes.hook: He threatens a damaging family disclosure.

episodes.title: What He Calls Exposure
episodes.entry: Amara refuses to buy silence about her past.
episodes.discovery: The threat loses its power over her decisions.
episodes.hook: Will the family publicly support the truth?

episodes.title: The Household Statement
episodes.entry: Orena acknowledges Ethan's relationship to Adrian.
episodes.discovery: A public denial used to obstruct the search is withdrawn.
episodes.hook: Kellan challenges the evidence chain.

episodes.title: Every Hand It Passed
episodes.entry: The player reconstructs the transfer chain.
episodes.discovery: There is no unexplained custody gap in the traced segment.
episodes.hook: A final receipt has a disputed time.

episodes.title: The Time We Can Prove
episodes.entry: An independent source establishes the receipt's time.
episodes.discovery: The team identifies the current placement instruction.
episodes.hook: A review can now use the authenticated timeline.

episodes.title: Before the Review
episodes.entry: David prepares the records while Amara prepares to speak.
episodes.discovery: Both distinguish proved facts from unanswered questions.
episodes.hook: The receiving office agrees to live verification.

episodes.title: Not Another Recording
episodes.entry: A trusted visitor verifies the call in person.
episodes.discovery: The next contact cannot be dismissed as a replay.
episodes.hook: The carer asks how Amara settles Ethan.

episodes.title: The Song She Knows
episodes.entry: Amara sings her familiar lullaby.
episodes.discovery: Ethan responds during the independently verified live call.
episodes.hook: The carer agrees to support his return.

episodes.title: A Statement for Tomorrow
episodes.entry: The carer's statement and placement are secured.
episodes.discovery: The next operation has a named place, witness and authority.
episodes.hook: The authority schedules a return assessment.

episodes.title: The Other Side of the Line
episodes.entry: The review accepts the factual chain.
episodes.discovery: Ethan is alive at a verified placement; a supervised return assessment is scheduled, not completed.
episodes.hook: Its notice names a representative Amara believed absent from Adrian's last night.
